name: io.github.AKzar1el/mcp-web-validator
title: Web Validator by DigestSEO
description: Validate HTML/CSS, audit SEO and JSON-LD, check links, and capture responsive screenshots.

tools.name: html.local
tools.title: Validate local HTML
tools.description: Validates local HTML/XHTML through W3C Nu, or an explicitly configured loopback Nu checker. Auto mode uses local fallback only for remote transport/transient failures; local mode keeps markup on the machine.

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to an HTML or .xhtml file.

checker.description: Default auto: W3C remote, optional configured local fallback. local: never sends file markup remotely.

tools.name: html.url
tools.title: Validate a public URL
tools.description: Fetches a bounded public HTTP(S) page, then sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. Private, reserved, credentialed, and nonstandard-port destinations are rejected.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL on port 80 or 443.

checker.description: Choose Nu remote, local loopback, or auto failover; URL retrieval is still public.

tools.name: css.local
tools.title: Validate local CSS
tools.description: Reads local CSS and either sends it to W3C Jigsaw (default), or performs offline Stylelint quality checks. Local lint results are advisory and cannot certify W3C CSS validity.

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a CSS file.

checker.description: Default W3C standards service; stylelint runs bounded local quality rules without network.

tools.name: seo.metadata
tools.title: Audit SEO metadata
tools.description: Audits supplied HTML offline for on-page SEO metadata, headings, viewport, image alternatives, and Open Graph issues. Use for a quick on-page check; use html.local/html.url for W3C HTML validation, schema.markup for JSON-LD syntax, or report.validation for a combined local-file report.

htmlContent.description: Raw HTML markup to inspect locally.

tools.name: content.duplicates
tools.title: Compare same-language main content
tools.description: Compares static main text across one to eight HTML pages supplied by the caller. Reports high-confidence exact matches and conservative near matches only within the same language (and script). No network requests or storage. Output is limited to this sample, not site-wide uniqueness.

url.description: Absolute page URL label only; no network request is made or query parameters accepted.

htmlContent.description: Already obtained static HTML, at most 250,000 UTF-8 bytes per page.

pages.description: One to eight HTML pages to compare; total HTML must be at most 1 MiB.

tools.name: content.quality
tools.title: Review empty, short and repeated main content
tools.description: Offline, evidence-limited review of empty or thin static main text and substantive repeated sentences within same-language page families. Reports possible missing standalone value, not Google rankings or a semantic quality verdict. Accepts up to eight supplied HTML pages; no network, storage, browser or LLM.

url.description: Absolute page URL label only; no network request is made or query parameters accepted.

htmlContent.description: Already obtained static HTML, at most 250,000 UTF-8 bytes per page.

pages.description: One to eight authorized HTML page observations; total supplied HTML must be at most 1 MB.

tools.name: site.hreflang
tools.title: Verify multilingual hreflang clusters
tools.description: Compares head-only hreflang and canonical declarations across up to sixteen supplied static HTML pages, including x-default, reciprocal references and same-locale target consistency. No URLs are fetched, and unsampled targets are not declared broken. Works across authorized domains; no browser, files or storage.

url.description: Absolute authorized page URL label; not fetched. Cross-domain alternate sites are supported.

htmlContent.description: Already obtained static HTML for that page; no network requests are made.

pages.description: Up to sixteen page observations; total supplied HTML must be at most 1.5 MB.

tools.name: links.broken
tools.title: Check public links
tools.description: Resolves and checks up to 25 public HTTP(S) links in supplied HTML. Redirects are reported but not followed, and response bodies are discarded.

htmlContent.description: Raw HTML markup containing links to check.

baseUrl.description: Optional public HTTP(S) base URL used to resolve relative links.

maxLinks.description: Maximum number of public HTTP(S) links to check, from 1 to 25.

tools.name: schema.markup
tools.title: Validate JSON-LD syntax
tools.description: Parses JSON-LD blocks in supplied HTML locally and reports empty blocks or JSON syntax errors. It does not validate vocabulary semantics.

htmlContent.description: Raw HTML containing JSON-LD script blocks.

tools.name: schema.supported
tools.title: Review supported Schema.org JSON-LD structures
tools.description: Offline bounded structural review of explicit JSON-LD for Article/NewsArticle/BlogPosting, Product, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Organization and WebSite. Checks limited property shapes and review-profile recommendations; unknown contexts/types stay unverified. Does not resolve remote contexts or certify Schema.org validity, Google rich-result eligibility, content truth or rankings. Use schema.markup for existing syntax-only diagnostics.

htmlContent.description: Caller-supplied HTML containing JSON-LD script blocks, never fetched, at most 250 KB UTF-8.

tools.name: report.validation
tools.title: Generate a validation report
tools.description: Combines W3C HTML/CSS validation, local SEO/accessibility checks, JSON-LD syntax checks, and a bounded public-link check into a Markdown and structured report.

htmlFilePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative HTML or .xhtml file path.

htmlChecker.description: Auto W3C remote with optional local Nu fallback; local avoids uploading markup.

cssFilePath.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative CSS file path.

baseUrl.description: Optional public HTTP(S) base URL used to resolve relative links.

tools.name: audit.monitor
tools.title: Dry-run regression monitoring of existing local audit history
tools.description: Manual, offline, read-only P2-02 regression/optional-alert PREVIEW for two to ten existing saved audit.history IDs in oldest-first order. Configurable 1–8 sampled regressed pages, net error/warning increases, 1–4 step regression streak and review-only coverage loss/sitemap drift. Candidate alerts require complete comparable observations with unambiguous chronology; nothing is sent, scheduled, persisted, fetched or connected to GSC/GA4.

ids.description: Two to ten already-saved distinct local history version IDs, oldest to newest; the archive is never modified by monitoring.

dry_run.description: Strictly manual simulation. Only true is accepted; no alert delivery or scheduling exists.

policy.description: Optional bounded manual-only thresholds and review toggles, not persisted or scheduled.

min_regressed_pages.description: Minimum number of regressed matched pages in the latest fully comparable sample (default 1).

min_net_error_increase.description: Minimum positive net change in observed error counts across matching completed pages (default 1).

min_net_warning_increase.description: Minimum positive net change in observed warning counts across matching completed pages (default 1).

min_coverage_lost_pages.description: Minimum previously completed pages now missing a complete check for a review-only observation (default 1).

consecutive_regressing_steps.description: Consecutive fully comparable regression transitions needed for the regressed-pages candidate (default 1).

review_coverage_loss.description: Include review-only validator coverage-loss observations without treating them as defects (default true).

review_sitemap_drift.description: Include review-only discovery fingerprint changes, never as defect alarms (default true).

min_regressed_pages.description: Minimum number of regressed matched pages in the latest fully comparable sample (default 1).

min_net_error_increase.description: Minimum positive net change in observed error counts across matching completed pages (default 1).

min_net_warning_increase.description: Minimum positive net change in observed warning counts across matching completed pages (default 1).

min_coverage_lost_pages.description: Minimum previously completed pages now missing a complete check for a review-only observation (default 1).

consecutive_regressing_steps.description: Consecutive fully comparable regression transitions needed for the regressed-pages candidate (default 1).

review_coverage_loss.description: Include review-only validator coverage-loss observations without treating them as defects (default true).

review_sitemap_drift.description: Include review-only discovery fingerprint changes, never as defect alarms (default true).

tools.name: crawler.logs
tools.title: Correlate supplied crawler access-log failures around a cutover
tools.description: V12/V13 local-only: correlate 1–16 important URLs across 500 supplied access observations, grouping failures and claimed crawlers. Optional verify_googlebot_ip_ranges=true downloads one fixed Google official common-crawler CIDR list and compares caller-supplied source IPs locally. Default is offline. No IPs, UAs, paths, logs, query or timestamps returned; no target-site fetch, log-provider connection, storage, DNS verification, Search Console or Google ranking causation.

site_origin.description: Public HTTPS origin shared by all important URLs and log paths, used only for local matching; never contacted.

important_urls.description: One to sixteen explicit same-origin public important URL labels without query/fragment; output uses index numbers, not URLs.

cutover_at.description: Offset-aware ISO cutover timestamp dividing supplied request evidence into before versus after; never echoed.

format.description: Use structured observations or Apache/Nginx combined access-log lines; exactly one source must be supplied.

observations.description: Only structured mode: 1–500 previously captured HTTP observations, not fetched or saved.

timestamp.description: Request timestamp with explicit timezone offset or Z; invalid values reduce coverage rather than being guessed.

method.description: HTTP method as observed; only GET/HEAD are correlated for crawl evidence.

path.description: Observed same-origin request path including optional query, never echoed. Unsafe encoded separators are excluded.

user_agent.description: Optional unverified User-Agent text, classified only as claimed crawler profile and never echoed.

client_ip.description: Optional source client IP for Googlebot range matching. Use trusted visitor IP, not reverse-proxy edge IP; never returned.

access_log.description: Only combined_access: up to 256 KB of Apache/Nginx combined access lines, max 500; IPs/referers/URLs/UA are not returned or stored.

verify_googlebot_ip_ranges.description: False by default. True requests one bounded GET of the current common-crawlers.json from fixed developers.google.com URL. All log IPs stay local; no other sites contacted, historical source IPs cannot be proven by current ranges.

tools.name: audit.production_change
tools.title: Compare two captured production HTML versions
tools.description: V10 offline exact-page comparison of two explicitly supplied timestamped HTML observations: SHA-256 HTML/main-text fingerprints, title/description/H1/canonical/robots, JSON-LD block counts and bounded internal-link and main-word changes. Non-200 delivery and incomplete evidence suppress content-change claims. No live fetches, storage, deployment, source-text output, Google indexing or ranking causation.

page_url.description: Exact safe page URL without query, fragment, credentials or custom port; not fetched.

observed_at.description: Earlier offset-aware ISO capture timestamp; supplied by caller, not independently verified.

http_status.description: Earlier observed HTTP response status; omit if unknown.

html.description: Earlier captured HTML body, up to 180,000 UTF-8 bytes; empty only for a failed response.

baseline.description: Earlier caller-supplied captured response. A non-200 status can have empty HTML.

observed_at.description: Later offset-aware ISO capture timestamp; supplied by caller, not independently verified.

http_status.description: Later observed HTTP response status; omit if unknown.

html.description: Later captured HTML body, up to 180,000 UTF-8 bytes; empty only for a failed response.

current.description: Later caller-supplied captured response. Timestamps are validated but not verified.

tools.name: audit.trends
tools.title: Compare two to ten locally saved site-audit history versions
tools.description: Read-only, offline longitudinal comparison of 2–10 previously saved local audit.history version IDs (oldest first). Uses only the existing compact audit archive, compares adjacent and first/last snapshots plus an exact fully-checked all-version cohort, separates coverage loss from real changes and gates issue-group disappearance on identical complete selected samples. No new site requests, archive mutations, scheduled checks or Google-indexing claims. Returns only redacted numeric evidence, never page URLs, issue messages or stored snapshots.

ids.description: Two to ten distinct IDs of already-saved audit.history versions in oldest-to-newest storage order. An evicted or missing version fails closed without changing the archive.

tools.name: audit.history
tools.title: Manage local audit history
tools.description: Opt-in local-only site-audit snapshot history. Save a previous hosted audit_public_site structured result as JSON, list saved IDs, or retrieve an exact version. A single compact local JSON file retains at most 10 versions; saving the 11th removes the oldest. No database, background task, or network request.

action.description: Save a snapshot, list versions, or retrieve one by ID.

snapshotJson.description: For save: JSON-serialized structuredContent from hosted audit_public_site, max 60 KB. Raw HTML is not stored.

id.description: For get: saved version ID returned by list or save.

tools.name: performance.crux_field
tools.title: Analyze Chrome UX Report real-user Core Web Vitals and trends
tools.description: V11-FIELD local: offline analyze an already-obtained Google CrUX daily or history JSON record, or make ONE explicitly requested free Google Chrome UX Report API query using an existing local CRUX_API_KEY environment variable. Reports origin/page, device-class p75 LCP/INP/CLS/FCP/TTFB and bounded historical points. Missing eligible data stays null. No GSC, GA4, visitor tracking, storage, scheduled requests, URL fetch, API-key echo or Google ranking/traffic causation.

source_mode.description: Use caller-provided JSON entirely offline or explicitly authorize one fixed-endpoint Google CrUX API request with local CRUX_API_KEY.

mode.description: Daily 28-day aggregated p75 data or up to 40 overlapping historical 28-day weekly windows.

granularity.description: Origin aggregates eligible Chrome experiences across the whole origin; url requests one exact page.

target.description: Safe public HTTPS origin or exact page label; query strings, fragments, private hosts and credentials are rejected. Never fetched directly.

form_factor.description: ALL aggregated devices, PHONE, DESKTOP or TABLET. Missing device data is not treated as zero.

record_json.description: Only supplied_record: original CrUX API JSON (max 300 KB UTF-8), containing matching record identity, metrics and collection period. Never stored or echoed.

tools.name: browser.lighthouse_lab
tools.title: Run isolated Lighthouse performance lab on supplied static HTML
tools.description: V11-LAB local-only: run the real Lighthouse engine once in pinned sandboxed Chromium against caller-supplied HTML served at a synthetic, isolated local proxy origin. Reports redacted Lighthouse performance score, FCP, LCP, TBT, Speed Index and CLS. All supplied executable page scripts and embedded frames are stripped, and all outbound resource requests are denied; no production URL, remote CSS/JS, CrUX field INP, ranking or indexing verdict. Chrome/Lighthouse may incur CPU and memory load; fixed 75-second deadline and 180 KB HTML cap.

html.description: Authorized static HTML markup for the isolated lab. It is not fetched or stored.

form_factor.description: Run one real Lighthouse performance-only lab simulation using mobile or desktop viewport emulation.

tools.name: browser.viewport_parity
tools.title: Compare isolated mobile and desktop rendering and native interaction evidence
tools.description: V09 local-only: compare the SAME authorized HTML in two fresh, network-denied Chromium viewports (375x812 touch/mobile and 1440x900 desktop), or fetch one robots-allowed public HTML 200 response for that isolated comparison. Detects mobile main content hidden vs absent in DOM, visible navigation/link differences, title/description/H1/robots/canonical/JSON-LD counts, horizontal overflow, bounded keyboard tab targets, small control dimensions and one safe native details tap/Enter. All page scripts and external CSS/JS/API assets are disabled, no arbitrary links/buttons clicked or forms submitted. Fixed counts/codes only, no raw text, URLs, IDs or screenshots in output. Not Google WRS, full-site SEO parity, full accessibility certification, or real hydrated browser behavior.

mode.description: Supplied HTML is rendered twice offline; public mode first fetches one robots-allowed page HTML response then compares it offline.

page_url.description: Only supplied_html: public same-origin page URL label for resolving links/canonicals; never fetched.

html.description: Only supplied_html: static/inline-CSS markup evaluated without scripts, network or remote assets.

url.description: Only public_html: safe query-free HTTP(S) URL; robots.txt checked before a single public HTML GET.

tools.name: browser.resource_failures
tools.title: Inspect bounded browser resource responses and loading failures
tools.description: V08 local-only: analyze up to 64 observed browser HTTP/network outcomes or navigate one robots-allowed public URL in fresh sandboxed Chromium with DNS-pinned proxy. Distinguishes real HTTP 4xx/5xx resource responses from transport failures, pending requests, and explicit tool-policy blocks. Groups script/CSS/document/API/image/font issues without returning URLs, headers, error text, response bodies or credentials. Browser allows same-origin assets by default, never private IPs; optional public third-party resource access is capped. Does not impersonate Google WRS or establish actual indexing, user experience, performance guarantees or causation.

mode.description: Choose offline caller-supplied resource observations or a guarded public browser network sample.

url.description: Only live_browser: one safe public query-free page URL; robots.txt is checked before browser navigation.

include_third_party.description: Only live_browser: explicitly permit public third-party assets from up to three additional origins; default false blocks them without calling them website failures.

observations.description: Only analyze_observations: 1–64 fixed-shape browser outcomes; no raw URLs or headers.

resource_type.description: Browser observed resource class, such as script, stylesheet, image or fetch.

origin.description: Same-origin, third-party or unknown request classification; do not supply a URL.

outcome.description: Observed HTTP response, transport failure, explicit tool block, or still-pending request.

status_code.description: Only for outcome=http: actual HTTP response status including 4xx/5xx.

failure_reason.description: Only for transport_failed: redacted DNS/timeout/TLS/connection/cancel/other category.

duration_ms.description: Optional observed elapsed request time in milliseconds.

additional_budget_blocked.description: Offline only: number of extra requests explicitly blocked when the browser observation limit was exceeded.

navigation_completed.description: Offline only: whether an independently observed navigation completed before the sampling deadline.

tools.name: browser.dom_diff
tools.title: Compare HTTP source HTML and sandboxed rendered DOM SEO signals
tools.description: V07 local-only: compare two caller-supplied raw/rendered HTML snapshots offline, or render caller-supplied HTML in fresh network-denied Chromium with inline scripts only, or fetch one robots-allowed public HTML page and sample its inline-script DOM. Detects changed/missing title, description, H1, text, same-origin anchor links, canonical, noindex and JSON-LD declarations using bounded redacted evidence. Does not load external JS/CSS/assets, impersonate Google WRS, access GSC/GA4, claim indexing or save content. Inline modes execute untrusted JS only inside fresh browser sandbox; external requests are denied.

mode.description: Choose offline caller snapshots, local Chromium inline-script execution, or a guarded public HTML fetch followed by the same isolated browser render.

url.description: Only for live_inline_sandbox: safe public query-free HTTP(S) page URL; robots.txt permission checked before GET.

page_url.description: For offline modes, the page URL label for resolving relative links and canonicals; never fetched.

raw_html.description: Caller-observed source HTML. Inline mode executes only its inline scripts in a fresh, offline Chromium sandbox.

rendered_html.description: Only compare_snapshots: rendered HTML already obtained by an authorized browser or source; never executed or fetched.

tools.name: browser.wcag
tools.title: Review bounded rendered-DOM keyboard and WCAG interaction evidence
tools.description: Local-only inert Chromium accessibility evidence: native keyboard focus, named controls and optional axe-core automated WCAG 2.2 rule scan (includeAxe=true). Author scripts and handlers stripped, all resources blocked, only trusted axe engine executes after inert rendering. Does not certify conformance or inspect full live site.

htmlContent.description: Caller-supplied authorized HTML only, never a URL or file path; scripts/frames removed, external resources blocked.

viewportWidth.description: Optional isolated desktop/mobile viewport width in CSS pixels, 320–1440; defaults to 960.

viewportHeight.description: Optional isolated viewport height in CSS pixels, 360–1080; defaults to 720.

maxTabSteps.description: Maximum real browser Tab key samples (1–24), default 24; no click, form submission or network.

includeAxe.description: Optional local axe-core WCAG 2.2 automated rules; CPU-intensive and not a conformance certificate. No new network access.

tools.name: media.diagnostics
tools.title: Review static images, video and media-loading evidence
tools.description: Local-only, offline review of caller-supplied HTML image alt/name evidence, responsive picture fallbacks, intrinsic dimensions, lazy loading/decoding/fetchpriority hints, video sources and caption tracks. Bounded and redacted; never fetches or renders media, executes scripts, measures layout, validates caption contents or certifies accessibility/performance.

htmlContent.description: Caller-supplied static HTML markup to inspect offline; no URL, resource or local file is fetched.

tools.name: site.sitemaps
tools.title: Review sitemap inventory, lastmod consistency and indexability conflicts
tools.description: V05: compare up to eight previously observed XML/text sitemap documents with independent discovered URLs and page response/indexability evidence, or sample one authorized public sitemap plus up to two same-origin children. Finds malformed/duplicate/cross-origin URLs, missing child documents, invalid/future/inconsistent lastmod, independent discovery gaps and sampled redirect/noindex/canonical/robots conflicts. The bounded live sample never fetches listed pages, stores source documents, returns raw URLs, claims full search-engine inventory or guarantees Google indexing.

url.description: Live mode: one authorized query-free public site URL; sitemap defaults to /sitemap.xml.

sitemap_url.description: Live mode optional same-origin sitemap URL, otherwise uses /sitemap.xml.

site_url.description: Offline mode: public site URL whose sitemap documents were observed.

documents.description: Offline: 1–8 previously observed XML or plain-text sitemap bodies.

sitemap_url.description: Same-origin, query-free sitemap URL; never echoed.

content.description: Observed XML or plain-text sitemap document, UTF-8 byte bounded.

content_type.description: Observed document content type; defaults to XML.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP status for this sitemap, if known.

discovered_urls.description: Optional independently discovered same-origin URLs; no site crawl is performed.

page_observations.description: Optional independent HTTP/indexability observations for up to 250 pages.

url.description: Independently observed same-origin page URL.

canonical_url.description: Observed page canonical preference, not Google-selected canonical.

noindex.description: Observed robots meta or X-Robots-Tag noindex declaration.

robots_allowed.description: Independently observed crawler robots permission, not inferred.

modified_at.description: Independently established significant modification date in W3C format.

documents_complete.description: Caller-verified completeness of all linked sitemap documents.

discovered_complete.description: Caller-verified completeness of independent site discovery.

observed_at.description: Optional W3C date/datetime clock for lastmod verification, defaults to now.

tools.name: http.redirect_chain
tools.title: Analyze observed HTTP redirects and canonical destination chains
tools.description: V04: review up to eight ordered HTTP response hops, Location redirects, static HTML/HTTP Link canonical declarations, and Googlebot-applicable noindex/robots observations, or probe a bounded public query-free HTTP(S) URL. Detects redirect loops, incomplete/mismatched chains, HTTP errors, canonical conflicts/cycles/chains and non-indexable sampled destinations. A destination is called wrong only relative to an explicitly supplied expected URL. Reports no raw URLs, HTML, headers, credentials, authenticated crawler observations or Google-selected canonical/indexing verdict.

url.description: Live mode: one authorized public query-free URL; bounded GET/redirect chain.

source_url.description: Offline mode: source URL, equal to the first supplied HTTP observation.

observations.description: Offline mode: one to eight ordered observed HTTP responses. No requests made.

url.description: Observed HTTP URL label, not echoed in the report.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP status code from this response hop.

location.description: Observed Location header when HTTP returned a redirect.

canonicals.description: Previously observed canonical href values, including HTTP Link declarations.

html.description: Optional static source HTML (150 KB UTF-8 cap), never executed or returned.

x_robots_tag.description: Optional observed X-Robots-Tag fields; [] means inspected and absent.

robots_allowed.description: Optional independent robots-access evidence; never inferred from the HTTP status.

expected_destination.description: Optional caller-defined expected final URL, compared only on a complete observed chain.

tools.name: crawler.access
tools.title: Review crawler access, robots rules and indexing directives by profile
tools.description: V03: compare up to eight supplied pages against robots.txt group precedence and static meta/X-Robots-Tag directives for Googlebot smartphone/desktop/news/image, Bingbot and GPTBot; or probe one public page and robots.txt using only the service's own User-Agent. Distinguishes crawl disallow from explicit noindex and unavailable/ambiguous evidence. Live probe obeys site robots for this service; it does NOT impersonate/verify real crawlers, request indexing, crawl historical logs, or claim a page is indexed. Raw URLs, source and response headers are not returned.

url.description: Live mode: one authorized public query-free HTML page; cannot be combined with supplied evidence.

site_url.description: Offline mode: public site origin URL matching all supplied pages.

robots_txt.description: Offline: previously obtained robots.txt body, max 64,000 UTF-8 bytes.

robots_status_code.description: Offline: observed robots.txt HTTP status; 429/5xx are unknown, not allow.

pages.description: Offline: one to eight same-origin static page and HTTP indexing observations.

url.description: Exact same-origin query-free page URL label, never returned.

status_code.description: Observed page HTTP status, if known.

html.description: Optional static raw HTML (150 KB byte cap); scripts are not executed or stored.

x_robots_tag.description: Observed X-Robots-Tag response header values; [] means checked and absent.

profiles.description: Optional distinct crawler product profiles; all six by default.

tools.name: http.availability
tools.title: Analyze observed availability changes and short repeat-fetch reliability
tools.description: V02: compare two to 48 ordered, caller-supplied timestamped HTTP/transport outcomes, or make two to three bounded sequential public GET probes. Flags intermittent non-2xx, status transitions, 429/5xx, explicit challenge and network failures, and sampling gaps. The percentages are only ratios of sampled responses, never guaranteed uptime or actual outage duration. No scheduler, history storage, Googlebot verification or response bodies; use availability.history separately to opt into local storage.

url.description: Authorized public query-free HTTP(S) URL for a short live repeat-fetch sample; omit for offline analysis.

checks.description: Live checks per call, two or three (default three); ignored for neither/invalid modes.

observations.description: Two to 48 real timestamped HTTP or transport outcomes, ordered oldest to newest; offline.

observed_at.description: Real observation timestamp with explicit UTC offset, in strictly increasing order.

status_code.description: Actual HTTP response code, mutually exclusive with failure.

failure.description: Explicit no-response failure class, mutually exclusive with status_code.

cf_challenge.description: Whether this HTTP response explicitly reported a Cloudflare challenge header.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed duration of this observed request in integer milliseconds, if measured.

tools.name: availability.history
tools.title: Capture and compare local availability history (ten records maximum)
tools.description: V02 local-only opt-in compact availability archive. 'capture' makes one public HTTP GET and saves only its HTTP/transport outcome and timestamp. 'list' and 'compare' read existing outcomes for exactly one authorized URL. A single 24 KB JSON archive retains a maximum of ten total observations and automatically evicts the oldest; no scheduler, Cloudflare/Google access, cloud storage, secret headers or response bodies. Capture writes local state and may evict old data.

action.description: Explicitly capture one HTTP observation into local storage, list saved outcomes, or compare at least two saved outcomes.

url.description: Exact safe query-free URL whose local observations should be captured or read.

observed_at.description: Real observation timestamp with explicit UTC offset, in strictly increasing order.

status_code.description: Actual HTTP response code, mutually exclusive with failure.

failure.description: Explicit no-response failure class, mutually exclusive with status_code.

cf_challenge.description: Whether this HTTP response explicitly reported a Cloudflare challenge header.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed duration of this observed request in integer milliseconds, if measured.

tools.name: http.delivery
tools.title: Diagnose live or supplied HTTP delivery and edge responses
tools.description: V01: one bounded public HTTP GET probe (up to three same-origin redirects), or one to four ordered caller-supplied response observations. Diagnose 403/429/5xx, redirect completeness, HTTP cache flags, Retry-After and Cloudflare challenge evidence. No body download, JS execution, Googlebot identity verification, monitoring, raw header values or query-bearing URL output. Supply exactly one of url or observations.

url.description: Authorized public query-free HTTP(S) URL to probe once (GET).

observations.description: One to four caller-observed response hops instead of live network traffic.

url.description: Safe query-free URL label of this already-observed HTTP hop; never echoed.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP response status code from this hop, never inferred.

method.description: Actual HTTP request method used for this observed response.

headers.description: Optional allowlisted response-header observations, not returned verbatim.

tools.name: http.variants
tools.title: Review supplied HTTP/HTTPS, www, slash, case and query URL variants
tools.description: Offline, bounded comparison of one explicit query-free reference URL and 1–12 caller-observed same-path candidate responses across HTTP/HTTPS, apex/www, trailing slash, ASCII path case and query parameters. Reviews one-step Location, up to three canonical declarations and optional caller-computed 200-response SHA-256 fingerprints. No URL fetch, redirect following, Google canonical selection, query-value leakage or content equivalence assumptions.

reference_url.description: Explicit query-free HTTP(S) preferred URL to compare against; must also be present as one supplied response.

url.description: Exact observed URL variant; query values are permitted for comparison but never fetched or returned.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP status, not a request result obtained by this tool.

method.description: Observed request method, if known; HEAD cannot supply a body fingerprint.

location.description: Optional one-step HTTP Location header value for redirects; may be relative; no redirect is followed.

canonicals.description: Zero to three actual observed canonical URL declarations, absolute or relative; not Google-selected canonicals.

content_sha256.description: Optional caller-computed SHA-256 hex of the exact HTTP 200 response body; never returned or independently verified.

observations.description: One to twelve already-observed URL response records in the exact reference path family; do not cause fetches.

tools.name: http.security
tools.title: Review supplied HTTPS, mixed-content and HTTP security evidence
tools.description: Offline, bounded security-header/static-HTML observation review across 1–8 same-host HTTP/HTTPS pages. Distinguishes declared HTTP→HTTPS redirects, HSTS status, enforced vs report-only CSP, safe/weak referrer and framing policies, nosniff and static mixed-content/form/CSS declarations. No traffic, TLS certificate verification, browser execution, security certification or sensitive raw URL/header/HTML output.

strict_transport_security.description: Up to four observed Strict-Transport-Security headers, in received order.

tools.name: http.directives

tools.description: Offline, bounded analysis of one to eight caller-supplied same-origin HTTP response header observations, including PDF/media MIME types, X-Robots-Tag (scoped Googlebot directives and contradictions), Link rel=canonical declarations, Content-Disposition and response status. No URL fetch, binary download, robots.txt inspection, Google indexing assertion, or storage. Sensitive raw URLs, headers, filenames and query tokens are not returned.

url.description: Safe same-origin resource URL label; never fetched or echoed.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP response status code, not a guessed crawler state.

method.description: Optional actual request method of this caller-supplied header observation.

content_type.description: Optional raw Content-Type HTTP response header value.

content_disposition.description: Optional raw Content-Disposition HTTP response header value; filenames are never returned.

x_robots_tag.description: Zero to eight X-Robots-Tag HTTP response header values, in received order.

link.description: Zero to eight Link HTTP response header values (including rel=canonical if present).

resources.description: One to eight authorized same-origin HTTP response header observations, no live network or binary fetching; 30 KB combined header budget.

height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels, from 200 to 4320.

methodology_id.description: Optional methodology ID associated with this dataset.

methodologies.description: Up to 16 methodology IDs and safe reference URLs supplied by the caller.

id.description: Short ASCII source, dataset or methodology ID; no tokens or private identifiers.

url.description: Public-style HTTP(S) source label, never fetched and without query, userinfo or fragment.

tools.name: site.link_graph
tools.title: Review sampled internal-link graph, depth and possible orphans
tools.description: V06: evaluate one to eight caller-supplied same-origin static HTML/page observations and up to 256 previously observed sitemap labels, or perform a guarded public sample of one robots.txt and up to three HTML pages. Counts standard anchor links including navigation, computes shortest sample-only entry paths, and flags nofollow-only, missing inbound, unobserved URL, blocked/HTTP-error, noindex and noncanonical targets. Orphan candidates are not verified site-wide orphans. No raw URLs/HTML, JavaScript, full crawl, Googlebot impersonation, PageRank, GSC or production changes.

url.description: Live mode: one authorized public query-free entry URL, at most three bounded same-origin HTML GETs after robots.txt permission.

site_url.description: Offline mode: site URL used as the exact-origin comparison scope.
